posts.body: Predictions: 10 of 10 Pending | Tied for 1st with 99 others Vukosavljevic vs. NegruAleksandar Vukosavljevic, TKO, R1Negru going pro is certainly a choice. He was looking good as an amateur but once forced to strike he got embarrassed badly. His striking is amateur level and he has no chin. I guess he’s being set up for a win but I can’t trust him after seeing him get put out cold twice in the amateur leagues

posts.author: pakee
posts.body: Predictions: 10 of 10 Pending | Tied for 1st with 99 others Batur vs. StamatovićMartin Batur, TKO, R1As much as I don't like to watch Batur fight, I can see him winning this one purely based on that Stamatović didn't impress me one but. Sure, he improved, but not as much as I expected. He is already 6-0 and I don't see him being a threat to anybody at the top of the Europe.Račić vs. CogliandroAntun Račić, SUB, R2I don't know, but I don't like this matchup, probably because it is co-main event and Cogliandro has lost 4 out of his last 5 matches. Račić has 13 submission wins and out of Cogliandro's last 5 matches he lost 3 of them via sub.Ančić vs. FerreiraMarko Ančić, SUB, R2Ferreira is a lot more experienced than Ančić, but if Ančić wants to prove us that he is a real deal, he needs to win this bout. Ferreira didn't lose one time on a decision, so I would think this time will be the same and he will be subbed in second round, of course as I said if Ančić is a real deal.Nazhand vs. StaropoliLaureano Staropoli, TKO, R2I don't know why I'm leaning towards Staropoli winning this one, but so be it.Kita vs. DajčmanMichał Kita, TKO, R1Hard to predict HWs, but with Kita's experience I think he will find a way.Milidragović vs. MoosmannLuka Milidragović, DECMoosmann only won against cans, so I can see Milidragović schooling him in the stand up.Dénes vs. PolityłoÁkos Dénes, TKO, R1If this fight goes on to the decision, Polytylo's gonna win, because of his awkward style. I reckon Denes will start pressuring him from the beggining and will finish him in under a round.Juric vs. GavanasJure Juric, TKO, R2Jurić is scary even on this level. On the other side, Gavanas disappointed me with his fight in Munich. His cardio is really bad and even though he is kickboxer, I predict Jurić will beat him in his own game, probably finishing him with GNP.Brkan vs. HillIlija Brkan, DECBrkan is one of those fighters from ATT Zagreb that improved so much after Luka Jelčić's coaching takeover there. Hill on the other side didn't even beat one fighter with positive score, so I don't know what to expect from him.Vukosavljevic vs. NegruAleksandar Vukosavljevic, TKO, R1I can see this go both ways, but after seeing Negru's performance at Oktagon, I am leaning towards Vukosavljević winning this one. * Edited at 04.28.2026, 8:44 AM ET *
